book: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
title: The Stone Table Hill
brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. The Stone Table stands on an open hilltop. Find a hilltop like it, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is the hill of the Stone Table. The book says it is “a green open space” where you can see the forest “in every direction.” This time you don’t build. You find a place.

lookfors.name: On top of a hill
lookfors.why: they climb uphill to reach it

lookfors.name: A view all around
lookfors.why: you can see far in every direction

lookfors.name: Room for a big stone slab
lookfors.why: “a great grim slab of grey stone”

steps.title: Know what to look for
steps.text: You won’t build today. You will find a hilltop like the Stone Table’s. Read the four things to look for. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Find it
steps.text: Walk and teleport to high ground. Find a green, open hilltop where you can see far in every direction.

steps.title: Look closely
steps.frame: “This could be the Stone Table hill because ___. When Aslan came back, Lucy and Susan felt ___.”
steps.text: Stand on your hilltop and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Stand on your hilltop and say this out loud. This could be the Stone Table hill because… When Aslan came back, Lucy and Susan felt…

extra.text: Turn to where the sun comes up. Say what Lucy and Susan saw at sunrise.

points: Your photo shows an open, green hilltop with a view.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each line from the book and tap who said it. Then finish two sentences about Aslan.
mapday.miss: Not that one. Think about who talks like that in Chapters 13 to 15.
mapday.done: ✓ You found every speaker. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: An open hilltop with a spot for each person who talks

clues.q: “Fall back, all of you, and I will talk to the Witch alone.”
